’26 SP MT1 [Hexa 1]

Reading

PLUM Reading 1 Unit 1~Unit 3 · Choose the correct answer.

Unit 1

I have a head. I have no hair. I have a mouth. I have no teeth. Who am I? The baby. I have two eyes. I have no noses. I have eight arms. I have no hands. Who am I? The octopus. I have three eyes. I have no heads. I have two legs. I have no noses. Who am I? Monster d.
1. Who has no hair?
A) the man
B) the baby
C) the octopus
D) the monster
2. How many arms does the octopus have?
A) one
B) two
C) three
D) eight
3. What does Monster d look like?
A) It has no heads.
B) It has two eyes.
C) It has three noses.
D) It has eight legs.

Unit 2

We are the same. We have two eyes. We have a nose. We have a mouth. We are different. We have different eyes. We have different noses. We have different mouths. We are the same. We see with our eyes. We smell with our noses. We speak with our mouths. We are different. We see different things. We smell different food. We speak different words. We are the same, but different.
1. How do we see?
A) with our mouths
B) with our noses
C) with our hands
D) with our eyes
2. What do we do with our mouths?
A) We see.
B) We smell.
C) We speak.
D) We listen.
3. What do we smell?
A) different food
B) different words
C) different eyes
D) different noses

Unit 3

Monster: Who are you? Bird: I am Bird. And I say, “Tweet! Tweet!” Monster: Who are you? Lion: I am Lion. And I say, “Roar!” Monster: Who are you? Cow: I am Cow. And I say, “Moo!” Pig: I am Pig. And I say, “Oink! Oink!” Monster: Who are you? Spider: I am Spider. And I say, “…” Lion, Bird, Spider, Cow & Pig: Who are you? Monster: I am Monster. And I say, “Fee-faw-fum!”
1. What is the story about?
A) Monster's friends
B) Lion and Cow
C) animal bodies
D) animal sounds
2. Who says, "Moo"?
A) Bird
B) Spider
C) Cow
D) Pig
3. What does Monster say?
A) Tweet! Tweet!
B) Roar!
C) Oink! Oink!
D) Fee-faw-fum!
